chunks: And with his chain of narration, he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever curses Ali has indeed cursed me, and whoever curses me has indeed cursed God.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of cursing Imam Ali in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* underscores the concept of *Mawadda* (affection) for the Ahl al-Bayt as a prerequisite for faith, linking the honor of Imam Ali directly to the Prophet and ultimately to God. It serves as a foundational proof for the inseparable spiritual authority of the Imams in Shia theology, where reverence for Ali is not merely personal but a reflection of divine honor.
